name: Unauthorized Security VLAN access
description: PC-1 pings SIEM-1 in the Security VLAN. CORE-SW1 denies it with STAFF-IN rule 20.

presentation.objective: Show that a staff computer cannot reach the Security VLAN.
presentation.security_rule: STAFF-IN rule 20: deny ip 10.0.10.0/24 to 10.0.99.0/24 (enforced by CORE-SW1).
presentation.explanation: The echo request is dropped at CORE-SW1 by the STAFF-IN ACL, so the animation stops there and PC-1 gets no reply. The ACL counter rises. IDS-1 sees the copy of the packet that entered the core, but it is passive and only the ACL blocked it.
expected: Every echo request is dropped at CORE-SW1 by STAFF-IN:20
The SIEM receives a CORE-SW1 enforcement event
No firewall or IPS action is involved
